description: Rather than requiring every magical item to have its own unique rules, ordinary equipment may receive additional Enchantments. Enchantments increase the equipment's battlefield value by their listed Points. A normal item may receive multiple compatible Enchantments, provided the equipment and enchantments are narratively appropriate. An individual Enchantment cannot normally be applied more than once to the same item.

minorEnchantments.description: Minor Enchantments generally provide modest improvements or a narrow specialization.

notes: The GM may adjust the Points of unusual Enchantments based on their scope and interaction with other properties. Items still follow normal characteristic limits.

knownIssues: The source Markdown's 'Minor Enchantments' and 'Major Enchantments' tables had lost their pipe-table formatting and rendered as a single run-on line of text. This was corrected directly in the Markdown as part of this conversion pass (restored as proper tables); no values were changed, only formatting.
